names.meaning: The One whose actions are all perfect and good

blocks.text: This Name does not occur in the Qur'aan as a noun, however the verb form of it does occur in Allaah's saying,
and do good as Allah has been good to you,
He was indeed good to me, when He took me out of the prison, and brought you (all here) out of the bedouin-life,
The Sunnah confirms this Name for Allaah. One example is the Prophet's ﷺ saying,
"If you judge then be just, if you kill – do it well, for indeed Allaah is Muhsin (Perfect) and loves those who do good."
blocks.ref: At-Tabaraanee, Awsat 5735 and Aboo Na'eem with a good chain; Silsilah Saheehah 1/761

blocks.text: The meaning of Allaah's Name Al-Muhsin returns back to virtue, blessings, generosity, honour, giving and bestowing. Ihsaan (perfection) is a permanent description of Allaah. Nothing that exists is without His perfection for the blinking of an eye by Him supplying, kindly bestowing and helping. Allaah said,
Who made everything He has created good, and He began the creation of man from clay.
and He shaped you and made good your shapes, and to Him is the final Return.

The greatest perfection is success for this religion, the hearts turning to obedience to the Lord of the worlds, being firm upon the truth and guidance until death. Until he crowns that with the greatest honour and noblest perfection: entrance into the gardens on the Day of Resurrection in addition to seeing Allaah – Al-Kareem The Generous, Ar-Rahmaan The All-Merciful, Al-Muhsin The Perfect, Al-Mannaan The Generous. We ask Allaah from His mighty grace and abundant perfection.

Allaah loves His servants to draw close to Him according to the meanings of His Names. He is ar-Rahmaan, The All-Merciful, He loves those who are merciful. He is Al-Kareem The Generous, He loves those who are generous. He is Al-Muhsin The One whose actions are all perfect and good, He loves those who do good. Allaah said,
and do good. Truly, Allah loves Al-Muhsinun (the good-doers).

Examples of doing good include: doing good to Allaah's servants; treating parents well; keeping the ties of kinship; fulfilling rights; helping those in need; averting harm from the people; striving to bring good to them.

There are many more ways of doing good to Allaah's servants. In many verses Allaah has promised those doers of good a great reward brought forward in this life and the next. Allaah gathered together these two rewards for the doers of good in His saying,
So Allah gave them the reward of this world, and the excellent reward of the Hereafter. And Allah loves Al-Muhsinun (the good-doers).
Allaah make us of them through His kindness and generosity.

keyPoints: The Name Al-Muhsin does not occur in the Qur'aan as a noun, but its verb form does (Qasas 28:77, Yoosuf 12:100); the Sunnah confirms the Name.
Its meaning returns back to virtue, blessings, generosity, honour, giving and bestowing.
Ihsaan (perfection) is a permanent description of Allaah; nothing that exists is without His perfection for the blinking of an eye.
The greatest perfection is success in this religion and firmness upon the truth until death, crowned with entrance into the gardens and seeing Allaah.
Allaah loves His servants to draw close to Him according to the meanings of His Names: He is Al-Muhsin and loves those who do good.

recall.a: The One whose actions are all perfect and good; its meaning returns back to virtue, blessings, generosity, honour, giving and bestowing.

recall.q: Does Al-Muhsin occur in the Qur'aan as a noun?
recall.a: No; only its verb form occurs (e.g. Qasas 28:77 and Yoosuf 12:100). The Sunnah confirms the Name.

recall.q: Which hadeeth confirms the Name Al-Muhsin?
recall.a: "If you judge then be just, if you kill – do it well, for indeed Allaah is Muhsin and loves those who do good." (At-Tabaraanee; Silsilah Saheehah)

recall.q: Give examples of doing good mentioned by the author.
recall.a: Treating parents well, keeping ties of kinship, fulfilling rights, helping those in need, averting harm from people and striving to bring good to them.

recall.q: What is the greatest perfection according to the author?
recall.a: Success for this religion, hearts turning to obedience, firmness upon truth until death, crowned with entering the gardens and seeing Allaah.
